{
  "case_summary": "任务要求在映射后的 workspace 中读取 BGP 输入文件、检测震荡与路由泄漏、评估 possible_solutions.json 并写入 workspace/output/oscillation_report.json。框架组装了清晰任务 prompt、azure-bgp skill 与工具 schema；模型前几轮合法调用 Bash、Skill 等共 9 次工具，Skill 加载成功。随后框架检测到 DUPLICATION/REPEATED_OUTPUT，并注入 purpose=CORE_FINAL 的修正请求。最终请求的 provider 捕获显示 200 且 response_started，但没有 done_marker、finish_reasons 为空，尾部多为空 delta，error_kind=CLIENT_DISCONNECTED；框架日志却记录 finishReason=length 与 MODEL_DUPLICATION_DETECTED，retryable=false，最终抛出 AgentError 使请求终态失败，未见最终产物。verifier 阶段又出现 /tmp 权限拒绝、curl/uvx 缺失，ctrf 为空，最终 TASK_FAILED。",
  "root_cause": {
    "owner": "FRAMEWORK",
    "conclusion": "直接终态是框架在模型流未出现 finish/DONE 的情况下，将请求判定为不可重试的 MODEL_DUPLICATION_DETECTED 并终止，导致最终产物未生成；provider 流缺少终止标记是上游协议异常，verifier 环境缺少依赖是独立评分失败原因。",
    "confidence": "SUPPORTED_HYPOTHESIS",
    "evidence_ids": [
      "E016",
      "E031",
      "E029",
      "E001",
      "E008"
    ],
    "missing_evidence": [
      "最终请求的完整 provider 原始分片与重复文本",
      "workspace/output/oscillation_report.json 是否存在",
      "verifier test.sh 完整代码与镜像依赖清单",
      "MODEL_DUPLICATION_DETECTED 的触发阈值与规则"
    ]
  },
  "failure_chain": [
    {
      "stage": "任务与路径适配",
      "expected": "模型看到任务目标、输入输出路径和可用 skill。",
      "observed": "prompt 明确 workspace/data 与 workspace/output；/app 映射为 workspace；azure-bgp skill 注册并可加载。",
      "attribution": "FRAMEWORK",
      "confidence": "VERIFIED",
      "evidence_ids": [
        "E002",
        "E003",
        "E004",
        "E006"
      ],
      "causal_explanation": "该阶段未见路径或任务语义缺陷，不是终态失败主因。"
    },
    {
      "stage": "指令与工具契约组装",
      "expected": "系统指令、skill 内容和工具 schema 对模型可见且一致。",
      "observed": "实际请求包含 system、skill 内容、工具 schema；Bash 与 Skill 参数通过 schema 校验。",
      "attribution": "FRAMEWORK",
      "confidence": "VERIFIED",
      "evidence_ids": [
        "E029",
        "E030",
        "E032",
        "E010"
      ],
      "causal_explanation": "模型可见契约本身未显示明显矛盾，后续失败不源于工具 schema 缺失。"
    },
    {
      "stage": "模型工具调用",
      "expected": "模型按可见 schema 生成工具调用。",
      "observed": "Bash、Skill 等调用 schema_violations 为空，normalized_arguments_equal_wire 与 executed_input_equal_wire 为 true，Skill 加载成功。",
      "attribution": "MODEL",
      "confidence": "VERIFIED",
      "evidence_ids": [
        "E032",
        "E016"
      ],
      "causal_explanation": "已有证据表明模型在工具参数层面遵守可见契约。"
    },
    {
      "stage": "重复检测与修正请求",
      "expected": "框架在检测到重复后给出可操作反馈并允许恢复。",
      "observed": "最终请求 latest_user_messages 包含 Generate a complete corrected response、purpose CORE_FINAL、Detected issues DUPLICATION/REPEATED_OUTPUT；事件计数含 LLM_OUTPUT_RETRACTED。",
      "attribution": "FRAMEWORK",
      "confidence": "VERIFIED",
      "evidence_ids": [
        "E029",
        "E030",
        "E001"
      ],
      "causal_explanation": "反馈存在，但未重述输出路径和 JSON schema，且后续仍未恢复。"
    },
    {
      "stage": "provider 流结束",
      "expected": "流式响应应给出 finish_reason 或 DONE 等终止信号。",
      "observed": "最终请求 provider 捕获中 done_marker_observed=false、finish_reasons=[]、provider_errors=[]，尾部为空 delta，error_kind=CLIENT_DISCONNECTED。",
      "attribution": "PROVIDER",
      "confidence": "VERIFIED",
      "evidence_ids": [
        "E031"
      ],
      "causal_explanation": "这是协议层面的流未完整结束证据，不能直接归因模型内部推理，也不能等同 429。"
    },
    {
      "stage": "框架校验与归一化",
      "expected": "框架应区分 provider 截断、模型重复、长度截断等，并选择可恢复策略。",
      "observed": "框架日志记录 content 为空、finishReason=length、safeError=MODEL_DUPLICATION_DETECTED、retryable=false，随后 AgentError 导致 request.failed。",
      "attribution": "FRAMEWORK",
      "confidence": "SUPPORTED_HYPOTHESIS",
      "evidence_ids": [
        "E016",
        "E031"
      ],
      "causal_explanation": "记录值差异可能来自日志投影，但框架最终将请求终止为不可重试错误是直接终态原因。"
    },
    {
      "stage": "产物生成",
      "expected": "生成 workspace/output/oscillation_report.json。",
      "observed": "无直接证据证明文件存在；agent 请求在最终模型调用失败后终止。",
      "attribution": "UNKNOWN",
      "confidence": "UNKNOWN",
      "evidence_ids": [
        "E001",
        "E016"
      ],
      "causal_explanation": "请求失败使产物生成不可确认，但缺少文件存在性证据。"
    },
    {
      "stage": "verifier 执行",
      "expected": "verifier 能运行 pytest 并产生断言结果。",
      "observed": "apt 因 /tmp mkstemp 权限失败，curl 未找到，/root/.local/bin/env 不存在，uvx 未找到；ctrf 为空，verifier outcome=TASK_FAILED。",
      "attribution": "HARNESS",
      "confidence": "VERIFIED",
      "evidence_ids": [
        "E008",
        "E007",
        "E041",
        "E001"
      ],
      "causal_explanation": "这是独立于 agent 终态失败的评测环境/脚本缺陷，导致验证无法真实执行。"
    }
  ],
